confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Swiss price levels, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately certain; hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July demand swings rates. FX was not verified against the RBA F11.1 table. The 2026-10-15 value comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page, and third-party figures cluster at about 0.695 to 0.696 USD per AUD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Switzerland's tourist-city price level, benchmarked to other Swiss destinations such as Bern and Interlaken. Lucerne is priced at the high end of European mid-sized tourist cities, with accommodation the least certain component.
